claude-plugins-official.note: Official Anthropic plugins: code-review, claude-code-setup (automation recommender), commit-commands

anthropics.note: Official Anthropic skills: skill-creator, mcp-builder, webapp-testing, frontend-design

superpowers.note: TDD/planning/debugging discipline framework by Jesse Vincent (v6.1.1)

vercel.note: Installed locally in .claude/skills and .agents/skills; can also be managed via npx skills add

wshobson.note: Large repository (185+ skills); install specific skills via npx

alirezarezvani.note: ML/MLOps skills; install via /plugin marketplace add alirezarezvani/claude-skills

thedotmack.note: Local SQLite+Chroma vector memory plugin; optional alternative to vendor/claude-memory (Supabase)

recommended.description: Multi-agent parallel code reviewer with confidence threshold filtering
Project analysis and automated recommendations for custom skills and MCP servers
Optional local-first SQLite/Chroma persistent memory layer (mutually exclusive with Supabase memory)

headroom.note: Optional: local-first prompt compression and cache alignment (requires: pip install 'headroom-ai[mcp]')

notes.setup: All active skills in .claude/skills and .agents/skills are auto-discovered at runtime.
notes.memory: Memory skills require vendor/claude-memory/install.sh to be run separately and Supabase config.
notes.docs: See docs/skill-sources.md and docs/integration-roadmap.md for roadmap tracking.
